question: What is done after observing his arms?
premises: flower is offered to his scent-anointed hands
inference: after observing the arms, one kindles them and offers flower
uncertainties: whether tayaivāsyārpayetpuṣpaṃ is one token or compound
plain_english: Having observed his arms, kindle them by Rudra-power; with that same power offer flower to his hands anointed with scent.
